summary: This note collects two film reviews of Singh Saab the Great, directed by Anil Sharma and starring Sunny Deol. The Times of India gave the film 3 out of 5 stars, praising its good intentions about reforming society and Sunny Deol's earnest performance in a melodrama. Taran Adarsh of Bollywood Hungama gave it 3.5 out of 5, calling it a typical Sunny Deol film that appeals to audiences who enjoy desi fare, especially single-screen viewers.
one_line: Collected reviews of the 2013 Hindi film Singh Saab the Great, directed by Anil Sharma and starring Sunny Deol.
key_facts: The Times of India gave the film Singh Saab the Great a rating of 3 out of 5 stars.
The Times of India review said that, like all films that talk of reforming society, Anil Sharma's Singh Saab the Great has its heart in the correct place.
The Times of India review said Sunny Deol's earnestness shines throughout the duration of the melodrama.
Taran Adarsh of Bollywood Hungama gave Singh Saab the Great a rating of 3.5 out of 5 stars.
Taran Adarsh described Singh Saab the Great as a typical Sunny Deol film that a section of the audience still enjoys.
Taran Adarsh praised the clapworthy dialogue, the raw appeal, and the undercurrent of emotions in Singh Saab the Great.
Taran Adarsh wrote that the film's "dhaai kilo ka haath" should appeal to those who relish "desi" fares.
Taran Adarsh said the film would especially appeal to the single screen audience.
The Times of India review described Singh Saab the Great as a melodrama.
The film Singh Saab the Great was directed by Anil Sharma, according to the Times of India review.
